summary.en: A card lifts, then grows into a full-frame window; the next scene grows from inside it.
summary.zh: 画面里的一张卡先抬起，再放大成全屏窗口，下一场从窗里长出来接管。

fits: Overview → the detail of one item (open this card, enter its world).
notFor: Two scenes with no part-whole relation; it then reads as a decorative wipe.

intent.en: Clicking into one item of an overview: the viewer feels they have entered that card's own world, not watched a wipe.
intent.zh: 像点开总览里的一张卡走进它的世界：观众感到是“进入这一项”，而不是看了一次擦除。

content.en: Wraps two scenes: an overview with at least one card (its rect on screen) and the next scene, which should be that card's detail; no text of its own.
content.zh: 包住两场：一场带卡片的总览（给出那张卡在画面里的位置），下一场最好就是这张卡的详情；自身不带文字。

fits.zh: 总览 → 其中一项的详情（点开这张卡，进入它的世界）。

notFor.zh: 两场没有整体与局部关系（读成花哨擦除）；镜头锁死的风格（strip、split、scroll）。

pairs.note: an overview of cards to open one from
the card that grows into the window

en: The world inside the window must be the opened card's detail; an unrelated scene turns it into a decorative wipe.
One transition per seam: no white flash or blur stacked on the growth.
Let the next scene really stop (hold ≥ 1 s) after the window fills; drifting parallax steals the read.
zh: 窗里长出的必须是被点开那张卡的详情；塞无关场景就成了花哨擦除。
一个接缝只用一式：放大途中别再叠白闪或模糊。
窗铺满后让下一场真停住（≥ 1 秒）再读；视差一直飘会抢走阅读。

upstream.name: 穿窗转场
upstream.summary: 页面内真实元素（卡片）放大成全屏窗口，新场景从窗内长出接管
upstream.use: 任何两镜衔接处（技法卡，分镜阶段排完镜头后逐个接缝选一式）

overlaps.note: same function bound to the strip film material
a ringed cell to the full frame, film material
pushes inside a still window instead of growing the window
